added_failures_note: Derived from the reviewed run's own baseline_suite and after_suite: both arms report failure_count 1 with the same id tests/standard_names/test_export_determinism.py::TestManifestDeterminism::test_no_commit_uses_stable_unversioned_timestamp, so base ids minus head ids is empty. suite-head3.log:739 and suite-base3.log both end in EXIT=1 with that id as their only FAILED line; the manifest attributes it to the SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH pin shared by both arms.

findings.text: The base-arm bullet attributes the one-test difference to 'the added absent-leaf test', but that test is @pytest.mark.graph (tests/standard_names/test_catalog_import_binds_published_paths.py:135) and the default addopts deselect graph (pyproject.toml:1084-1091); the two arms both collect 8548 tests and the difference is a skip-status flip (12 skipped at base vs 11 at head, from the worktree-versus-archive git guard at tests/standard_names/test_pipeline_version.py:53), so line 46's 'both arms run the same way ... so neither depends on a git checkout' is also contradicted by the log headers.

item_verdicts.call_sites: Verified the int-subclass write result and the binding read through graph_catalog.py:158, :168 and :2210, and confirmed no production module reads result.unbound_paths (only the writer's logger.warning at graph_catalog.py:471 and :531 surfaces it).
item_verdicts.diff: Read both commits against e48d99642: b5313743a replaces the string-built container leaf with a graph-confirmed one and adds the orphan-array test, e0f4c528b rewrites the fragment's binding and gate sections; no path outside the declared scope.
item_verdicts.done_when: The done-when asks for both new tests failing on main and passing at head plus zero added failure ids; negative-control-main2.log carries all five new ids failing at base with EXIT=1, head-new7.log carries 5 passed with EXIT=0, and the two suite arms share their single failing id so added ids are 0, though the arms still differ in skip status so they are not strictly like-for-like.
item_verdicts.goal: The node goal is that the source audit reports sourceless live drafts and the catalog import binds every published DD leaf path or reports it; the reviewed delta advances the import half by refusing to bind a container whose leaf node is absent, and graph_catalog.py:466 now returns reason leaf_not_found on the write result.
item_verdicts.manifest: Read; it records the gate command verbatim, the three log paths, both suite arms with the shared failure id and an environment attribution for it, the five-test negative control and a rubric line for every dimension.
item_verdicts.write_paths: The declared paths are export.py, graph_catalog.py, the two new test files, the evidence fragment and the figure directory; git diff --stat e48d99642 e0f4c528b lists only graph_catalog.py, tests/standard_names/test_catalog_import_binds_published_paths.py and the fragment, all inside that set.

justifications.durability: negative-control-main2.log fails test_container_whose_leaf_is_absent_is_reported at base (EXIT=1) and head-new7.log passes it at head, and its assertion compares against a literal expected dict rather than any value it handed in.
justifications.evidence: suite-head3.log:739 (1 failed, 8536 passed) and suite-base3.log (1 failed, 8535 passed) share the single failing id, but the arms are 8548 collected both and differ 12 skipped vs 11, so they are not fully like-for-like and the fragment's explanation of the one-test difference is wrong.
justifications.fit: graph_catalog.py:466-470 names the new reason by mechanism (leaf_not_found / no_bindable_leaf) and both added CYPHER aliases are mechanism-named, matching the module's existing result idiom at graph_catalog.py:27-41.
justifications.goal_fidelity: graph_catalog.py:440-470 makes a resolved leaf count only when the graph returns it, so the container-with-absent-leaf case the node goal forbids is now reported instead of silently unbound.
justifications.reuse: _published_dd_paths_by_name now delegates to source_paths.split_source_paths and merge_source_paths (graph_catalog.py:54-72), closing the prior duplication finding; no shared owner exists for the container-to-leaf reduction, which stays inside the pairing read at graph_catalog.py:424-443.
justifications.scope_discipline: git diff --stat e48d99642 e0f4c528b shows exactly the three declared paths - graph_catalog.py, the import test and the evidence fragment - and nothing else.
